title: London meetup - update
content_html:
Hi,

After discovering that the original pub is indeed very busy on Sundays and finally finding a pub that will accept a large table booking, the Lobsters London meetup is now taking place at The Counting House, 50 Cornhill, London EC3V 3PD.

We are meeting at 1pm on 15th November.

See you there.
